# bartleby

> > bartleby is a comprehensive academic assistance platform providing textbook solutions, homework help, and study tools across multiple disciplines including engineering, geography, and philosophy.

bartleby offers expert-written solutions, Q&A support, and writing tools to help students with their coursework. The platform covers a wide range of subjects from STEM fields like mechanical and electrical engineering to humanities subjects like philosophy and geography.
